newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's YUKOS names new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Russia's YUKOS names new chairman.

text.p: Russian oil group NK YUKOS has appointed its former chief executive, Sergei Muravlenko, as its new chairman of the board of directors, YUKOS said on Wednesday.

Rosprom is the industrial holding company attached to Bank Menatep, a leading Russian bank which controls YUKOS. YUKOS is one of the biggest vertically integrated Russian oil groups created over the last few years. Its main operating unit is Yuganskneftegaz.

Muravlenko replaces Mikhail Khodorkovsky, who takes over as chairman of the combined executive board of Rosprom and YUKOS. Muravlenko, who is chairman of the board of Rosprom, also retains the title, but not the functions, of YUKOS president.

YUKOS sharesholders agreed on February 19 to merge the managements of the two groups. YUKOS will retain separate management structures for oil production and refining, but other functions will be handled directly by Rosprom.
